sample_reviews.text: AK Plumbing sorted our leaking pipe quickly and at a fair price. Very professional and tidy — would definitely recommend to anyone in the area.

sample_reviews.author: James T
sample_reviews.text: Called out for an emergency on a Saturday morning and they arrived within the hour. Brilliant service, really saved the day. Can't thank them enough.

sample_reviews.author: Linda H
sample_reviews.text: Had our bathroom fully refitted by AK Plumbing. The work was done to a high standard and they kept us informed throughout. Very happy with the result.

brand.about_paragraph: I'm the owner of AK Plumbing, based in Chipping Sodbury and serving Bristol and the surrounding communities. With years of hands-on experience across domestic plumbing, boiler work, and bathroom installations, I take pride in delivering honest, high-quality work every time. Whether it's a routine service or an emergency callout, you can count on me to get the job done right.
